Consider the following textbook-based statements:
I. Collective Sangam-era designation for the Cholas, Cheras and Pandyas — Tirumaleri, Maraneri, Kaliyaneri and Kadaneri.

சரியான விடை எது?

I is correct; II is incorrect
I is incorrect; II is correct
Both I and II are incorrect
